name: Smith Machine Shrug
steps: Stand facing the bar at thigh height and grasp it overhand just outside shoulder width.
Release the hooks, stand tall and let your arms hang straight.
Shrug both shoulders straight up toward your ears by contracting your upper traps firmly.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the bar slowly back to full shoulder depression.
tips: Lift your shoulders strictly vertically without rolling them forward or backward.
Keep your elbows straight so your arms act purely as hooks holding the bar.
